dialect.detail: NIST CCVS85 version 4.2 (April 1993) conformance test suite, program IC114A. Tests subprogram inter-call with FILE SECTION, WORKING-STORAGE SECTION, and LINKAGE SECTION in a called subprogram (IC115).
evidence: ON-SITE VALIDATION, NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STD & TECH

purpose.domain_detail: NIST COBOL Compiler Validation System (CCVS85) conformance test for inter-program communication and subprogram file I/O
purpose.summary: IC114A is a main program in the NIST CCVS85 test suite. It calls subprogram IC115 to create and verify a sequential file, then makes subsequent calls to read records back and validate their contents. It reports pass/fail results to a print file using the standard CCVS reporting framework.

notable_features: NIST CCVS85 standard test harness boilerplate
CALL to external subprogram IC115 (9 CALL statements)
Tests FILE SECTION, WORKING-STORAGE SECTION, LINKAGE SECTION in subprogram
Sequential file I/O within called subprogram
REDEFINES clauses on numeric/alphanumeric computed/correct fields
'S' and 'Y' indicator columns used for conditional compilation lines
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars (471 total lines); the PROCEDURE DIVISION test logic after line ~032300 is not shown but the program structure is clearly identifiable as NIST CCVS85. The 'S' prefix on EXIT PROGRAM and 'Y' prefix on page-overflow lines are CCVS conditional-compilation indicators, not standard COBOL.
